unit: USD-equivalent target; tools resolve to local App Store / Play price points and local currency. Values are the intended shelf price BEFORE local VAT/GST where stores add it on top.
annualMonthlyRatio: ~7.5x monthly (annual is priced at roughly 7.0-7.7x the monthly rate, i.e. a ~36-42% discount vs paying 12x monthly). iOS annual sits slightly above Android annual within each tier.
notes: Corpan is offline-first with ~$0 marginal cost per subscriber, so the strategy is volume via localized willingness-to-pay capture. Prices target at or slightly below Duolingo Super (individual) in each market. iOS >= Android within every tier; the iOS premium widens in mid/low tiers because the iPhone installed base there skews much wealthier than the Android base. Tiers ordered T1 (richest) -> T8 (lowest).

High income - peripheral / Southern + Central Europe, Gulf (ES, IT, PT, GR, CZ, PL, EE, SA, KW, BH, ...)
